notes: Setup → Family: four buttons at the top – Family Calendar (opens in a new tab), Today & tomorrow, Where is everyone and Reconfigure the family – then the children side by side with everything showing
Setup: the tabs are in two groups, “Set up” and “Everyday”
The holiday countdown’s settings are under Widgets
Setup → Screen layout: clicking a widget shows how it appears (height, show, when to show, remove) on the left and its own settings on the right, saved together – no page picker (drag it instead)
A widget shown in place of another at other times opens straight to its own settings
Each copy of a widget has its own settings. A new copy starts with the first one’s settings; removing a spare copy drops its settings; removing the last one keeps them for next time
